title: Dinner Lady Salts Strawberry Watermelon 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Strawberry Watermelon from Dinner Lady a sublime pairing of two exquisite fruit flavours. Juicy, sweet, sun-ripened Strawberries and luscious, mouth-watering Watermelon make for a blissful partnership and a super-satisfying all-day vape. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production while the Nicotine Salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices and is available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strength. Unlike regular freebase e-liquids, nicotine salts’ alkaline formulation allows for a higher concentration of nicotine while delivering a smoother throat hit than high-strength freebase liquids are capable of. Nicotine Salt e-liquids are absorbed into the bloodstream faster, providing near-instant relief from nicotine cravings. This makes Nic salt e-liquids a great choice for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by Nic salts. Dinner Lady have earned their fame as one of the most popular and inventive e-liquid makers in the UK through their talent for conjuring the most nostalgic e-liquid flavours beloved by vapers everywhere. Founded in 2016 in Blackburn, Lancashire, the vape lifestyle brand now distributes e-liquid worldwide to over 80 different countries. With their enormous fanbase and dedication to producing only the highest quality e-liquids, Dinner Lady keeps on ringing the bell for vapers all over the world.
